name: Oosumi Shou
source:
His primary job is an office worker, but he distributes games as a hobby.

Keisuke and him got to know each other through that connection, and they often play games together. They're yet to meet face-to-face, however...

[Translated from [url=https://skt-pnt.netlify.app/myteacher]official website[/url]]
